notes.title: The Lantern Update
notes.content:
[p]Hi All,[/p][p]Firstly I need to extend a huge thank you to everyone. The Inkshade launch is going exceedingly well, and I’m truly touched by all the kind things people have been saying. I’m also ecstatic that so many people are enjoying the game. The whole point was to make something that brings even a little bit of delight to others, and Inkshade seems to be doing that with great success.[/p][p]I especially want to thank the people who have helped get the word out by sharing Inkshade online, mentioning it to your favorite creators, or even just telling your friends about the game. I’m just some random person making stuff, and so I have neither a publisher nor a giant corporate budget for things like promotional campaigns. The fact that the game is reaching so far on its own is really, [i]really[/i] awesome.[/p][p]And even more awesome still is the growing fanbase–I appreciate how patient and chill everyone is, and I am genuinely excited to continue making games for all of you.[/p][p]Anyway, the main reason for this post is to talk about a new update that I think a lot of people will appreciate, so here’s the scoop on that:[/p][p][/p][h2]The Lantern Update[/h2][p][i]v1.1.010[/i][/p][p]Perhaps the most requested feature across every channel has been the ability to use the lantern at-will. With a few exceptions, this update lets you use the lantern whenever you want![/p][p][/p][h3]At-Will Lantern[/h3][p]Long story short, I have gone through the entire game, the entire lighting system, and the existing lantern system, and revamped everything to work with a togglable lantern. This included a lot of reprogramming of certain things, and also fixing up a lot of stuff hiding in crevasses that were never meant to be illuminated (I was hiding a [i]lot[/i] of shame in those shadows).[/p][p]Things will also work as they did before if you want to keep playing with the old lantern. All the automatic lantern triggers are still in place, so the manual lantern isn’t required. Well, except for some new spooky events, that is…[/p][p][b]Note:[/b] if your keyboard only has one control key, you may have to go set the lantern toggle keybinding in the settings.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Events[/h3][p]I’ve added a couple new events, sequences, and game master interactions related to this new lantern system. Also a couple little hidden details depending on how these events intersect with existing cinematic sequences. You should encounter them in a normal playthrough, and most of them will trigger on existing saves too.
[/p][h3]Brightness Bump[/h3][p]You’ll now find a “Contrast” slider in the graphical settings, right below “Gamma”. A lot of players tend to crank up the gamma, which has the tragic effect of making everything desaturated, so the contrast can be used to counteract that.[/p][p]However, since it’s a little annoying to fiddle around with graphics sliders for long periods of time, I’ve also added a “Brightness Bump” button right below these sliders. This button will automatically adjust the exposure, gamma, and contrast settings to values that will give you a relatively balanced, but ultimately brighter experience. (Please note that you may still need to tweak the settings to get the best experience on your monitor.)[/p][p][/p][h2]Other News[/h2][p][/p][h3]Inkshade OST[/h3][p]I almost forgot to mention that the Inkshade OST is now fully uploaded to the [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/@studiovezelle"]Official YouTube Channel[/url][/u]! You can find the complete playlist [url="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHjJFs81pV0pwmiibI6F3copt9fyQchLk"][u]here[/u][/url]. I am not exactly a crack composer, but a surprising number of people have asked about getting their hands on the OST, so here it is if anyone wants to give the tracks a listen. It may also come to Steam as a downloadable soundtrack one day, but exactly when is to be determined.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, that’s all for now!
[/p][p]As always, thanks for playing.[/p][p]–Vezelle[/p]

tags.feature: Perhaps the most requested feature across every channel has been the ability to use the lantern at-will. With a few exceptions, this update lets you use the lantern whenever you want!

Long story short, I have gone through the entire game, the entire lighting system, and the existing lantern system, and revamped everything to work with a togglable lantern. This included a lot of reprogramming of certain things, and also fixing up a lot of stuff hiding in crevasses that were never meant to be illuminated (I was hiding a [i]lot[/i] of shame in those shadows).

I’ve added a couple new events, sequences, and game master interactions related to this new lantern system. Also a couple little hidden details depending on how these events intersect with existing cinematic sequences. You should encounter them in a normal playthrough, and most of them will trigger on existing saves too.

You’ll now find a “Contrast” slider in the graphical settings, right below “Gamma”. A lot of players tend to crank up the gamma, which has the tragic effect of making everything desaturated, so the contrast can be used to counteract that.

However, since it’s a little annoying to fiddle around with graphics sliders for long periods of time, I’ve also added a “Brightness Bump” button right below these sliders. This button will automatically adjust the exposure, gamma, and contrast settings to values that will give you a relatively balanced, but ultimately brighter experience. (Please note that you may still need to tweak the settings to get the best experience on your monitor.)

I almost forgot to mention that the Inkshade OST is now fully uploaded to the [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/@studiovezelle"]Official YouTube Channel[/url][/u]! You can find the complete playlist [url="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHjJFs81pV0pwmiibI6F3copt9fyQchLk"][u]here[/u][/url]. I am not exactly a crack composer, but a surprising number of people have asked about getting their hands on the OST, so here it is if anyone wants to give the tracks a listen. It may also come to Steam as a downloadable soundtrack one day, but exactly when is to be determined.

notes.content:
Lantern Update Notes
- The lantern can now be toggled at-will after being found (left control key by default; you may have to rebind the key in the rebinding menu if your keyboard has only one control key).
- New events and game master interactions have been added.
- A contrast slider and "Brightness Bump" button has been added to the graphics settings menu.
- A great gaggle of adjustments and tweaks have been made to make the exploration environments compatible with an at-will lantern.

Additional Patch Notes
- Fixed a bug where the collection box would fail to unlock under certain conditions.
- The Overkill achievement can no longer be unlocked if an enemy unit overkills an object unit.
- Other minor bug fixes, visual fixes, typo fixes, and adjustments.

notes.title: General Update (7 days remain!)
notes.content:
[p]Hi All,[/p][p][/p][p]A few things to update on today![/p][p]
First is that Inkshade was accepted into the [b]Tiny Teams[/b] festival! This one is run by the Yogscast people and dedicated towards games made by small teams. There will be a bunch of creators showcasing all sorts of indie games this week if you want to check out some cool indie titles.[/p][p]~~~[/p][p]For game-related news I want to announce that the post-game mode that I’ve been working on will be available on release! It’s called [b]Journey of the Vagabond[/b], and it unlocks after you’ve beaten the game. Simply continue your save and carry on for a bit from where it leaves you off, and the game master will explain the rest. I don’t want to spoil how it works exactly, but in a nutshell you can turn the regular game into a true roguelike using the ominous skull totem pictured below. And by “roguelike” I mean that there isn’t any meta progression in Journey of the Vagabond, so you have to rely on strategy, planning, understanding of the game, and a bit of luck to complete a run in one go. And of course the really [strike]insane[/strike] hardcore players will be able to combine this mode with most of the existing challenge modes for extra fun.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226424/4ed08718b2a3a64f676cb5aa237c1c3f0fa40176.png"][/img][/p][p]On a different note, I also want to formally thank everyone who left even the smallest morsel of feedback for the game. Either on the Discord, in the Steam Community, in random YouTube comments, or anywhere else.
[/p][p]I gave everything consideration, and tried to add/tweak as much as I could without delaying the game too much. Not every suggestion made it into the release version of Inkshade, and some things would require too much of a ground-up rebuild to implement, but I want you to know that these things will still have an impact. Specifically a lot of the feedback will influence how I design future titles. I’ve learned quite a lot about all sorts of things that people like/don’t like, and have a suite of mechanical desires that will be front-of-mind if I make another game in a similar genre. (As well as a few key changes to certain design decisions that are going to influence pretty much every future game I make).[/p][p][/p][p]But really, as far as Inkshade goes, it’s at least ten times as good as it would have been without player feedback. Thanks again, and I sincerely hope you enjoy the full game when it releases on the 14th.[/p][p]~~~[/p][p]The last thing I want to mention today is… [b]The game is coming out in 7 days[/b]! A lot of you probably caught the release date announcements already, but I just wanted to take a little moment to hype it up again. Being excited about video game releases is one of my favorite things, and I remain delighted to be making something that at least a few people are excited for.[/p][p]
Oh, also there will be an extra-fun trailer dropping on the [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/@studiovezelle"]Official YouTube Channel[/url][/u] on launch day if you aren’t already subscribed, as well as some more musical uploads ♪ ♫♩[/p][p][/p][p]See you on the flip side,[/p][p]Vezelle[/p]

notes.title: Next Fest is here, Captain...
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Today is a very exciting day with a whole bunch of news!

[h3]🕹️ NEXT FEST DEMO[/h3]
First of all, Steam Next Fest has started, and Inkshade is taking part!

If you haven’t tried the demo yet, now is the time to give it a go. If you’ve already played the demo, there's plenty of reason to return: there are [b]New Challenge Modes[/b] in the demo [i]right now[/i]. Five total, in fact!
[list]
[*] [b]Double Pain Mode[/b]: enemies deal double damage to player pieces!
[*] [b]Unleashed Mode[/b]: more enemies and elite enemies will spawn!
[*] [b]Berserk Mode[/b]: all enemies are permanently aggroed! (This one really amps up the required tactics)
[*] [b]Copycat Mode[/b]: your upgrades also apply to enemies!
[*] [b]One Run to Rule Them All[/b]: entirely different run rules. You start with no upgrades and a small amount of scrip, and you have to carefully upgrade as you go. Grinding can’t save you here, Captain.
[/list]
You can activate the challenge modes from the right-most tab in the options menu. They also stack if you really want to make the game impossible.


[h3]🍿 NEW TRAILER[/h3]
I made a special trailer just for Next Fest!
https://youtu.be/1YyPF9R27j8
It highlights all the aforementioned challenge modes :)


[h3]🏅 KEY GIVEAWAY CONTEST[/h3]
Last time I mentioned a special contest to win a free game key. Well for the next week, I’m conducting a Look & Find challenge! There are 3 Easter eggs hidden in the demo that nobody has found yet. Roll on over to the [i]big-announcements[/i] channel in the official [url=https://discord.gg/VSFwH3aq8V]Discord[/url] to get at the contest form. This form will show you screenshot hints for these Easter eggs. If you can locate them, fill out the form with details of where exactly they appear in the demo. After Next Fest concludes, I will randomly select a person from those who found all the Easter eggs, and that person will receive a [b]free game key[/b] when Inkshade is fully released!

Happy hunting!
(And yes, all these Easter eggs are based on shenanigans from our Discord.)


[h3]🪔 LASTLY…[/h3]
I should also mention that the Inkshade demo won’t be up forever. So now really is the time to give it a whirl, or let your friends know about the demo if you think they might like the game.

Anyway, thanks for tuning in and checking out my game. As always, I will do my best to create something that delights you the same way that games are constantly delighting me.

Until next time, Captain.
–Vezelle

notes.title: Inkshade – Coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3]It’s Festival Season[/h3]
I'm happy to announce that Inkshade has been selected to be part of TurnBasedThursdayFest next month on June 2nd, and will also be featured in the Six One Indie Showcase on May 22nd! Like with past events, the demo will update with another new challenge mode for the duration of these festivals. Which challenge modes exactly are still a secret!

As a personal aside: I can't quite state how cool it is that this thing I'm making is getting into all sorts of events, but I am extremely humbled that people are interested. So big thanks to everyone who has checked out the game so far, and be sure to check out these festivals to see some other cool indie titles!

[h3]Steam Next Fest![/h3]
On top of that, Inkshade will be in the upcoming [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], which takes place June 9th to 16th! Steam Next Fest is a really, [i]really[/i] big deal for indie games. And so to give everyone a reason to come back to the demo during Next Fest, I will be updating it to unlock [b]all five challenge modes[/b] all at once for the duration of the festival. This includes two that will be brand new, and one of them will change how you approach runs quite a bit.

I will also be holding a special [b]contest[/b] during Next Fest, the prize for which will be a [b]key for the full game[/b]. Tune into the official [url=https://discord.gg/VSFwH3aq8V]Discord[/url] to catch the details when the festival starts on June 9th.

[h3]Game Progress[/h3]
As for game updates, I’ve made quite a lot of progress on all sorts of small quality of life features. This ranges from tweaking hitboxes to make things feel more clickable, to allowing players to see their active crew when selecting new pieces. As well as a pile of optimizations, some bug fixing, and a few more accessibility options in the game settings.

I’ve also added a new encounter type—the hex site. This is a special node where you can pay a mysterious stranger to grant boons to your pieces, curses to the enemy pieces, or buy special mutations that cause more drastic changes to all pieces, friend and foe alike. This should add some extra spice to each run, while also offering more opportunities for long-term strategy within a run.

Anyway, that’s all for today!

See you on the flip side, Captain.
–Vezelle

notes.title: Inkshade Official Announce
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I’m very excited to say that Inkshade has been officially announced!

This comes with a whole bunch of fun news:
[list][*]First is that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3141310/Inkshade/]Steam page[/url] has graduated to “Coming Soon”. The exact release date is still TBD, but I have a target in my sights.
[*]The key art has been completely redone! The main piece is in the Steam capsule art, and I feel like the end result is beyond awesome :)
[*]The [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=29xFuOiztSc]TRAILER[/url] has been updated and uploaded to YouTube—go give it a watch and all that good stuff and maybe we can convince the YouTube algorithm to help get the word out! I will also be dropping other trailers and fun things on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@studiovezelle]Studio Vezelle YouTube channel[/url] in the future if you aren’t subscribed but want to stay in the loop.
[*]There’s a sign-up form for closed demo testing over on the [url=https://discord.gg/VSFwH3aq8V]Discord[/url] server. If you’re interested in early playtesting, that’s where you’ll find out more.
[*]Inkshade has been selected to be in the SUGOI Showcase 2025! (This is the same group that did The Game Awards for Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards). The event is digital, and it’s happening on March 27th. Tune in on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SUGOIgames]SUGOI Showcase 2025[/url] Youtube channel and give Inkshade some love if you can.
[*]Guess what else is happening on the 27th? The Inkshade Demo is going PUBLIC. I hope you’re ready for a blanket of vibes. If you know anyone who might be interested in checking out the demo, shoot the Steam page their way. Anyone who has wishlisted should automatically get an email from Steam when the demo goes live.
[/list]
Anyway, thanks for checking things out! Now if you’ll excuse me, I have to go make Inkshade’s shroud of atmosphere even weightier.

See you on the other side, Captain.
–Vezelle
